topics.summary: During a radio show, callers discuss their sexuality while attempting to win concert tickets. topics.summary: Howard discusses his fascination with the Sioux Nation, references calls about Michael Blake’s acceptance speech and Oscar win, bizarre anecdotes including a bodyguard protecting actor Kevin Costner's son at a party, and negotiations for Scott Shannon to host a radio show in Los Angeles falling apart due to Andy Bloom’s loose talk regarding a potential deal.

topics.title: Stern’s Frustration with Jackie’s Laughter
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, Howard Stern expresses his frustration as guest Jackie Penhouse repeatedly laughs inappropriately during a discussion about a brother company commercial and a lettering system for keyboards. He attempts to get her involved in promoting the product but is continually disrupted by her laughter, leading to exasperation with her behavior.

topics.title: Howard Discusses Media Attention and Seaweed Baths
topics.summary: During a conversation, Howard Stern discusses his diminished media attention following an event and describes his nightly ritual of taking seaweed baths in his bathroom while watching television with candles and incense.

topics.title: Bath Rituals and Movie Stars
topics.summary: A caller details a bizarre bath routine involving exposing breasts while immersed, followed by Richard Lewis discussing his upcoming movie with John Candy, Jim Belushi, Jamie Lee Curtis (whom he criticizes for her lack of sexual appeal), and dating Shawn Young.

topics.title: Shawn Young’s Frustrations
topics.summary: The program features Shawn Young repeatedly complaining about his romantic life, detailing unsuccessful relationships and unwanted attention from callers. He expresses frustration over the difficulties of managing connections while frequently lamenting that others are ‘giving it to him for nothing.’

topics.title: A Confused Discussion on Sexuality
topics.summary: During a radio segment, two hosts engage in an increasingly confused and tangential conversation about the concept of ‘gay,’ referencing potential medicalization, societal norms, attraction, and personal preferences. They explore ideas surrounding sexuality with little coherence or clear direction.

topics.title: Detroit Shooting and Lesbian Relationships
topics.summary: During this broadcast, hosts discuss the fatal shooting of a man returning from the Persian Gulf due to marital strife involving his wife and brother-in-law. The conversation then shifts to relationships within a lesbian community, including details about dating practices and personal experiences with attraction, revealing an interest in diverse relationship dynamics.

topics.title: Insurance Policy & Seaweed Wraps
topics.summary: A man discusses his wife’s unusual behavior – taking out a large insurance policy on herself before going to the Persian Gulf and emptying their bank account, along with frequent visits to an institute for seaweed wraps. Conversations involve discussions about Natasha, the masseuse, and potential involvement in various individuals.

topics.title: James Brown’s Parole and Police Investigations
topics.summary: The conversation pivots to James Brown's recent parole, focusing on claims of police brutality during his incarceration. Details emerge about a high-speed chase and alleged beatings alongside discussions regarding drug testing requirements for release; the topic then shifts to personal wellness routines including seaweed wraps offered by an unnamed individual.

topics.title: Frost Discusses Clapton's War Views
topics.summary: During a radio interview, David Frost questions Eric Clapton about his opinions on the war, with Clapton expressing frustration over perceived manipulation by President and stating he believed it could have been a destructive conflict. The segment then shifts to discussing a British soldier’s unusual medical case involving a skin graft.
